answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Work waits on the karst until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the summit of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tide of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
